tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.description:
Canonical API selection tool for endpoint discovery and ranking.

Use this first to get the top recommended operations for a user intent.
Supports optional constraints plus tag-scoped selection via preferredTags,
excludedTags, or a curated tagPack key.

tools.name: list_tag_packs
tools.description:
List curated tag packs for large tool catalogs.

Use this to narrow exploration (for example social-media or enrichment).

tools.name: list_all_endpoints
tools.description: List available Descovo API endpoints with optional tag/search filtering.

tools.name: get_endpoint_details_full
tools.description:
Get COMPLETE schema and details for a specific API operation.

Use this BEFORE calling an API to understand exactly what parameters are needed.

Args:
    operationId: The operation ID (e.g., "syncContactEnrichment")

Returns:
    Complete schema including all required/optional fields, request body

tools.name: call_operation
tools.description:
Execute any Descovo API operation by operationId.

IMPORTANT:
- apiKey is NOT required in the body if the MCP client sends an x-api-key header (most configs do). The backend auto-injects it.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_endpoint_details_full" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get COMPLETE schema and details for a specific API operation. Use this BEFORE calling an API to understand exactly what parameters are needed. Args: operationId…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "call_operation" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
